title: Grateful Dead Live at Stadium, U.C Santa Barbara on 1973-05-20
lineage: MC> R> C> DAT> HD> SHN> CD

ai_review.summary: Stunning 5/20/73 Santa Barbara show captured on a high‑quality audience recording, highlighted by a smoking Truckin > The Other One > Eyes sequence and Jerry’s unusually sweet vocals.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this May 20, 1973 performance as one of the year’s top shows, especially praising the seamless jam from “Truckin” into “The Other One” and finishing with a transcendent “Eyes of the Sun.” The audience‑sourced matrix delivers crystal‑clear vocals and a balanced mix that many say even outshines contemporary soundboard tapes. Overall the show is described as cosmic, memorable, and technically impressive.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are 4‑5 stars, consistently praising both the musical performance (standout jams, sweet vocals) and the excellent audience recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience matrix captures clear vocals and a well‑balanced mix; reviewers note Bill’s drum sound is strong on the board but the overall blend sounds better in the audience source. No major dropouts or muffiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows organically, building from a solid first half into an epic second‑set jam that showcases the band’s improvisational chemistry and keeps the energy cosmic throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as singing 'so sweet'—his vocal tone is highlighted as unusually clear and pleasant.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming is noted as sounding especially good on the soundboard, contributing to the powerful wall‑of‑sound feel.
